name: Mortis (Grave's Decay) — Advanced — Dissolve the Flesh

system.description: You can enforce the effects of time and decay upon even the flesh of your fellow undying Cainites, turning all or part of your victim to dust. Extract two Blood Traits and spend a Willpower Trait charging them with the power of decay, then bring that blood into contact with your target (which may call for a Physical Challenge). Once the blood touches the victim, portions of her body transform to dust, as with Destroy the Husk. Each round thereafter, the victim must make a Static Physical Challenge against your Mental Traits or suffer one level of aggravated damage as more of her turns to dust. Once she has achieved as many successes as you have Willpower Traits, the power runs its course. While dissolution takes place, the victim is two Traits down on all challenges from the agony. Regeneration occurs at the usual rate for aggravated damage. One who has been reduced wholly to dust meets Final Death.
